display_name: Refresh the model capability catalog from live cross-checked sources
description: Returns data {job_id, status: queued} after persisting the request. Read service_interface::job_service::get_job with that exact job_id; schedule another read while queued or processing. Only a terminal successful job provides the original complete response in job.result (the original data is job.result.data); failures preserve the original response in job.result and the error in job.error. Do not repeat the operation because its completion has not been read. iss_d136ae29 (2026-09-21, catalog_stale); discovery per iss_0e805222 and iss_52fdb8e5 under rul_473f772f. The catalog learns which models exist from the providers' own lists, not from a table of ours: the launching Codex binary's own `debug models` listing and Claude Code's own local model cache decide existence, the exact launch id and the offered efforts. Score and cost come from Artificial Analysis: every row of the leaderboard table (effort-suffixed display name, creator, score, cost, and its own link to the model's detail page) is joined to a harness model by an exact normalized name, with one reviewed alias row and a report of near misses (alias_candidates), never a guess. A cell is created for each harness-listed model that has a leaderboard row at an effort on the ladder, at most 30 new cells per run (the rest are deferred, not dropped) and none once 300 live rows exist; a leaderboard row no harness model matches, or a creator with no runtime, is counted and never becomes a cell. Each cell is reconciled against an explicit tolerance (2.0 absolute Intelligence Index points; 5% relative on cost-per-task): two agreeing pages accept it, disagreeing pages move it to crosscheck_conflict, and when the model's detail page is missing the leaderboard reading is accepted alone with a note naming why, provided it is within tolerance of the cell's prior accepted value (otherwise the prior value is kept and the cell is reported as single_source_unconfirmed). A model with no leaderboard reading creates no cell and never a pending_crosscheck one; a harness-listed model the leaderboard no longer scores keeps its last score, stays accepted, and is named under unrenewable_stale. A page that parses fewer than 40 rows is a failed source; a score outside 0-100 or a negative cost is rejected and the prior value kept. When a harness list cannot be read the refresh says so and creates only flagged cells whose derived launch id has a well-formed shape. A manual cell (record_model_capability_cell) that the live sources renew takes the default staleness window; a manual reading the live pages disagree with stays served and is reported under manual_conflicts. The Codex binary is a named optional parameter of the verb (codex_binary, an absolute path, never looked up on PATH); the registered process does not pass it yet, so a live run reads Codex's cache file as a degraded list and says so. This is the only verb that can move a cell to accepted -- seed_model_capability_catalog only ever writes pending_crosscheck. A source that fails to fetch is named in sources_failed on both the return value and the written model_capability_refresh_run row, never silently dropped, and does not abort readings from the sources that did succeed.
embedding_description: Discovering which AI models the Codex and Claude Code harnesses actually offer, fetching their live capability scores and per-task dollar costs from two real external pages, cross-checking them, and writing accepted or conflicted catalog rows so dispatch tier selection has accepted cells to choose from.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: job_id and status=queued. Retrieve the exact job; the former final response is in job.result. run_id, trigger, readings_gathered, sources_ok, sources_failed, cells_accepted, cells_conflicted, cells_unchanged, cells_created (and created), creation_capped, creation_suspended, deferred, unrenewable_stale (per model: runtime, model, efforts, last_measured_at, age_hours), alias_candidates, harness (per runtime: status, source, detail, client_version, models_offered, advisories), unmapped_creators, efforts_outside_vocabulary, listed_not_launchable, creator_label_unmatched, single_source_unconfirmed, manual_conflicts, advisories.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: A queued receipt confirms acceptance only. Retrieve the terminal job before presenting any outcome. State which sources fetched cleanly and which failed (by name, not just a count), each runtime's harness list status (ok, degraded, unreadable or empty) and what that means, how many cells were created and how many are deferred, and how many cells moved to accepted vs. crosscheck_conflict vs. stayed unchanged. Name the models in unrenewable_stale (listed by the harness, no leaderboard row, still served with their last score) and any manual_conflicts or alias_candidates. A run with zero cells_accepted is not itself an error -- say plainly whether dispatch selection is now unblocked.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: select_dispatch_tier can now serve any cell this run (or a prior run) moved to accepted. read_model_capability_catalog with include_unaccepted=true shows conflicted and withdrawn cells too. A model the harness lists but the leaderboard does not score needs record_model_capability_cell if its value must be refreshed. An alias_candidates entry is a reviewed one-line change to the join alias table, never automatic.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Two harness list reads (Codex `debug models`, Claude Code's cache file), one leaderboard fetch and one detail-page fetch per discovered cell, then per-cell reconciliation and a state write per cell, all through the state interface. Not retryable: a retry after a transient fault whose write already landed would open a second refresh run for the same intent rather than resuming the first.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: parameter_invalid: trigger is missing or not one of manual/cron/policy_change/selector_stale (selector_stale is the trigger of a refresh queued by a selection made from stale readings). refresh_fetch_failed: the fetch layer raised an exception the source-by-source failure handling could not absorb (a harness list that cannot be read or a page that fails to fetch is reported in the result, not raised). catalog_invalid: a reconciled outcome or a stored runtime was not one the catalog knows. state_service_unavailable: the state service is not bound.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For refresh_fetch_failed, check whether artificialanalysis.ai is reachable; per-model detail-page failures alone do not raise this -- they are recorded in sources_failed and that cell is accepted on the leaderboard alone with a note, or kept as it was. A thin leaderboard page (fewer than 40 rows) is a failed source named in sources_failed: check whether the page's structure still matches the parser. A degraded or unreadable harness list is named under harness with its cause; restore the cache file or supply the launching binary. A state fault leaves the run row status=running; re-running the refresh opens a fresh run.
